Home.intro:
Yoooo, I'm Lucas!

A french software developer based in the heart of Paris, France, with a focus on crafting high-quality websites and applications.
Home.creativeMindset: I love tackling projects with a creative approach. My process usually starts with a good brainstorming session, lots of inspiration-hunting, and diving deep into the latest tech tools. Whether it's building from scratch or refining an existing idea, I aim to create with both quality and originality in mind.

availability.question: Are you available right now?
availability.answer: For freelance, yes: evenings and weekends. For a full-time job, let's talk… as long as the project is exciting and the salary is just as exciting.

remote.question: Do you work remotely?
remote.answer: Yes, and it's a must. I'm based in Paris, but I work fully remote.

stack.question: Your favorite stack right now?
stack.answer: React and TypeScript on the front, and mostly NestJS on the back. Basically the whole TypeScript ecosystem, from the browser to the server.

proudestProject.question: The project you're proudest of?
proudestProject.answer: Predi.GG, no doubt. It's the best and most polished thing I've built so far, and you can check it out in my projects. Feel free to install the app, by the way ;)

howSiteIsMade.question: How is this site made?
howSiteIsMade.answer: Next.js and React in TypeScript, with Tailwind. The click sounds are synthesized live in your browser, my Discord presence comes in real time, the arcade scores are replayed by the server so nobody can cheat, and all the content is edited from my own admin, which commits straight to GitHub. There are a few secrets too, but I'll let you find them.

lolMain.question: Your League of Legends main?
lolMain.answer: Vayne and Yunara, AD main since day one my guy, that's NOT changing

coffeeOrTea.question: Coffee or tea?
coffeeOrTea.answer: Definitely coffee. Paris runs on it, after all!

whyImjustlucas.question: Why imjustlucas?
whyImjustlucas.answer: It's my reminder to keep it real and stay humble, no matter where I go in my career.

ollie.name: Ollie
ollie.tagline: skate a Paris street: kickflips, grinds and combos
ollie.game: Ollie, a skate game: Lucas rolls down a Paris street that gets faster and busier level after level. Jump the cones, bins, benches and low pigeons, skate under the high ones, press again in the air for a kickflip, land on a bench to grind it, chain tricks for a combo up to x5 and pick up sparkles, worth more the faster you go.
ollie.hint: space, ↑ or click to jump, again in the air to kickflip, esc to pause
ollie.hintTouch: tap to jump, tap again in the air to kickflip
ollie.started: Run started. Jump with space, press again in the air to kickflip.
ollie.empty: nobody on the board yet, your turn 🛹

rules.jump: jump space, ↑ or click, hold to fly higher
rules.jumpTouch: jump tap the street, hold to fly higher
rules.kickflip: kickflip press again in the air, and land it: touch down mid-flip and you're on the pavement
rules.kickflipTouch: kickflip tap again in the air, and land it: touch down mid-flip and you're on the pavement
rules.grind: grind land on a bench and ride it, points all the way
rules.combo: combo clear things with a kickflip, a grind or under a pigeon to climb up to x5. a plain jump over something drops it back to x1
rules.pigeon: high pigeons stay on the ground and skate under them
rules.sparkle: sparkles worth more the faster you go, times your combo
rules.level: levels every 30 seconds: faster, busier, and night falls

surf.name: Surf
surf.tagline: ride the swell, the tubes and the gulls
surf.game: Surf, a surf game: Lucas rides a living swell. Pop him up through each gap between the rocks and buoys below and the pilings and gulls above, ride through the gates down on the water, stay low through the tubes, pass right in the middle of a gap for a perfect, chain perfects for a combo up to x5, pick up shells, worth more the faster you go, and catch a dolphin to be saved from one hit. A new level every 10 gates.
surf.hint: space, ↑ or click to pop up, again to climb higher, esc to pause
surf.hintTouch: tap to pop up, again to climb higher
surf.started: Run started. Pop up with space.
surf.empty: nobody on the board yet, your turn 🏄

rules.pop: pop up space, ↑ or click, again in the air to climb higher
rules.popTouch: pop up tap the sea, again in the air to climb higher
rules.ride: ride no press and you ride the swell: the low gates are passed on the water, and a big set lifts you for free
rules.tube: tube when the wave closes, stay low on the water: points all the way, a pop and you hit the lip
rules.perfect: perfect right through the middle of a gap (or riding a low gate) for a bonus, in a row for a combo up to x5. any other pass drops it to x1
rules.shell: shells off the easy line, worth more the faster you go, times your combo
rules.dolphin: dolphin a rare one swims with you and saves you from one hit
rules.level: levels every 10 gates: faster, narrower, diving gulls and sharks, from dawn to night
